newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania end-Jan cen.bank fx reserves $812.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Romania end-Jan cen.bank fx reserves $812.2 mln.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Wednesday its total foreign exchange reserves slipped to $812.2 million in January from $855.2 million at end-1996, after servicing the country's external debt.
Foreign reserve assets in the banking system rebounded to $3.14 billion at the end of last December from $3.04 billion in November. Data on January reserve assets were not available.
End-1996 reserve assets include gold reserves of about 88 tonnes, Special Drawing Rights and hard currency reserves of local banks and of the BNR.
Romania's external debt servicing is estimated at about $1.5 billion this year.
Central bank governor Mugur Isarescu said last month that the BNR was expecting to raise medium- and long-term loans worth up to $1.6 billion from international markets in 1997.
The BNR serviced about $1.2 billion on external debts last year when it drew $1.4 billion from world capital markets.
